combat.attack_hit: You strike the {actor}. It takes {damage} damage. ({remaining} HP remaining)
combat.ally_joins_attack: The {actor} strikes alongside you for {damage} damage!
combat.cannot_attack_ally: The {actor} fights at your side; you cannot raise a hand against it.
combat.defeat_drop: From the settling dust, something remains: {items}.
combat.actor_drained: The spiral drinks the {actor}'s strength. ({damage} HP drained, {remaining} HP remaining)
combat.drain_sigil_spent: The grey light runs out of the spiral and it powders to dust. The drain is spent.
combat.actor_wakes_hostile: The {actor}'s eyes snap open. It turns to face you.
combat.hostile_strike: The {actor} strikes you! You take {damage} damage. ({remaining} HP remaining)
conversion.encircled: The {actor} shudders, its surface brightening. It turns toward you, no longer hostile.
conversion.encircled_follows: The {actor} falls in behind you. You slow a little, so it can keep up.
follow.actor_follows: The {actor} follows you, a quiet step behind.
item.used: Warmth spreads from the {item}. You feel mended.
conversion.ring: The {actor} lowers its head and falls in behind you. You watch for a moment, then turn to go.
shaman.reveal: The chamber falls still. At the shaman's back, where its staff lay, a seam in the cave floor grinds open and a rough stair descends into a soft, phosphorescent glow. The first cave is yours.
shaman.memory: For a moment the settling dust hangs still, and in the quiet you understand: the chalk in your hand and the chalk rings holding the golems are the same thing — lines. A life you almost forgot rises up to meet you: the weight of a smooth stone, the grid of a Go board beneath your hands, and a voice that taught you that capture is just surrounding. Someone in this cave learned the same lesson, once, and built it into stone. The memory is gone almost as soon as it comes. But you know now how to read this board. You have played it before.
king.defeated: The elf king falls. The forest holds its breath. Then, one by one, the other elves lower their weapons and step back. No ring binds them — they simply choose to let you pass. You feel their eyes on you a long moment, and you lower your own blade.
item.scroll_read.learned: The dry bark is cool in your hand. The spiral unrolls behind your eyes, exact as a dictated rule: drain — take the strength of what stands within the circle and hold it until it holds nothing at all. The lines settle into your hand. You know the drain sigil.
item.spawn_scroll_read.learned: The fire-cured bark is cool against your palm. The amber circle resolves into a dictated rule: spawn — call one creature into the empty space. What answers, and how strong it stands, depends on the strength of the hand that draws it. The lines settle into your hand. You know the shape.

item.acquired_inventory.text: The inventory scan picked up the {label} — you've got it on you now. Keep it close. Sorry, that came out like an order.

item.acquired_room.text: I have the {label} down at your position — it should be right there on the ground. Let me know if the scan's lying.

item.consumed_player.text: The monitor shows the {label} used. Are you all right? I mean — vitals look stable. That's what I meant.

item.consumed_actor.text: {consumer_name} accepted the {label}. The guide says that's expected. I don't know how the guide would know, but okay.

item.consumed_use.text: The {label}'s registering as used. Good. I think that worked.

item.take_nothing: I'm not showing anything there to take. Check the floor anyway; the scanner misses things.
item.take_not_here: I can't locate that item at your position. Sorry.

item.taken.text: Got it. The {label}'s in your inventory now. I checked the list twice.

item.takedenied.text: Leave the {label} where it is — the field notes say it's anchored to the floor. I'd rather not find out if they're wrong.

item.drop_nothing: Your inventory's empty, or my panel is. At least, that's what my panel says.
item.drop_not_have: I can't find that in your inventory. If you can see it and I can't, tell me and I'll trust you over the readout.
item.drop_equipped: The procedure says you have to unequip the {label} before you drop it. I know, it's a rule with extra steps.

item.dropped.text: The {label}'s on the ground at your position now. I've got it logged. I log everything.

equipment.equipped.text: The {item}'s showing equipped — {bonuses}. Does that feel right to you? I can only see numbers.

equipment.unequipped.text: Okay, the {item}'s stowed. Off the board, so to speak.

equipment.not_equipped: The {item} isn't equipped. I checked twice.
equipment.already_equipped: You already have the {item} equipped. Sorry—the panel made it look like it hadn't updated.
error.command_not_now: Hold on, Layla. The procedure won't let you {verb} right now.
error.command_needs_more: Not yet. The checklist still needs: {labels}. I know. I'm sorry.
error.command_blocked_by_progress: The system won't let you {verb} again. It already marked these ready: {labels}.
error.cannot_command_here: I can't authorize `{command}` from there. The playbook says you need to be in the {room} first.
error.missing_item: I don't see any {label} ready in your inventory.
error.nothing_to_consume: There's nothing available to consume. Please don't try something unlisted.
error.no_actor_to_serve: There's no one there to serve. That's the wording in the procedure, not mine.
error.no_actor_to_listen: I don't have anyone nearby who can listen.
error.no_target: I can't identify a valid target near you.
error.target_required: I need a target before I can clear that action. Try: {actors}.
error.trace_mark_exists: You already traced a {label} there. The SOP says one of each kind per room.
error.no_craftable_available: There's nothing new you can make there. I checked the unlock table.
combat.no_effect: The {kind} passes over the {actor} like wind over stone. No damage is done.
elemental.release: The fire elemental does not fall — it lets go. Its fire unknots, loosens, and the spiral in its chest unwinds like a long-held breath. It is released back to the elemental realm, and the board is suddenly, quietly cool. You stand at the edge of the pit and let it go.
conversion.fire: The {actor} flickers once, then settles at a low, steady glow. It turns to you, no longer afraid, no longer opposed. You hold still in the drift of its warmth.
